segments.name: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles
segments.description: Develops and sells passenger-grade unmanned aerial vehicles, which customers operate on a limited trial basis in tourism locations in China.
segments.evidence: As a whole and hence, the Group has only one reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the company for passenger-grade UAVs, with most revenue from a limited number of customers trialling them at tourism locations.
revenueModel.evidence: For the years ended December 31, 2023, 2024 and 2025, the majority of the Group's revenue generated from sales of passenger-grade UAVs are from a limited number of customers that mainly operate the UAVs on a limited trial basis in tourism locations in China, rather than in broad, mainstream commercial operations.
